items.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
items.description: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.

items.title: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
items.description: The US has threatened to isolate nations that continue to do business with Tehran, which sells much of its oil to Beijing.

items.title: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
items.description: Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft travelled to Russia from the US via Latvia on Tuesday.

items.title: Mass arrests in global crackdown on West African cyber-crime networks
items.description: The operation included the arrest of 39 people in South Africa for romance and investment scams.

items.title: Brain disease in dead NFL players 'higher than previously shown'
items.description: A new study says at least one in four ex-NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had a degenerative brain disease but the true figure could be much higher.

items.title: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
items.description: The south-western village of Pomas was hardest hit, with hundreds of homes damaged and fifteen people taken to hospital.

items.title: European rights court orders Turkey to free imprisoned businessman
items.description: Philanthropist and activist Osman Kavala has spent almost a decade in jail over charges rights groups say are politically motivated.

items.title: Nigeria's president orders manhunt after kidnappers upload victim video
items.description: The footage shows dozens of men, women and children sitting in a forest.

items.title: Lockerbie bombing trial postponed days before it was due to start
items.description: The trial of a Libyan man is delayed for a third time, after new evidence on the 37-year-old case came to light three days ago.

items.title: Swedish military seeks to take over Russian-owned estate near naval base
items.description: The armed forces request the seizure of the plot near Muskö Naval Base citing threats from Russian drones.

items.title: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania
items.description: Cases in the US have hit the highest point since the virus was eliminated, as vaccination rates decline.

items.title: French tourist dies in Death Valley after car gets stuck in mud
items.description: The 68-year-old man was found dead in California's salt flats amid 116°F (46.6C) heat.

items.title: US firefighters say major blaze near Reno about a quarter contained
items.description: But officials fear that winds could fan the flames for two more days, as many locals remain under evacuation orders.

items.title: Kit Harington replaces Nicholas Hoult in HBO's Harry Potter series
items.description: Hoult was announced as Gilderoy Lockhart two weeks ago but has dropped out due to scheduling issues.

items.title: NZ religious sect leader jailed over death of Chinese follower
items.description: The body of 70-year-old Shulai Wang was found near a marina in Auckland in 2024.

items.title: US removes Syria from list of state sponsors of terrorism
items.description: The Trump administration has embraced Syria's new president, former al-Qaeda linked militant Ahmed al-Sharaa.

items.title: Sonya Massey's killer Sean Grayson dies in US prison
items.description: The former police officer, whose crime reignited the debate about US police brutality, was undergoing treatment for cancer.

items.title: King of Norway's health has worsened, palace says
items.description: Norway's King Harald remains in hospital receiving antibiotics for a bloodstream bacterial infection.

items.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
items.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.

items.title: Caste divide makes summer more scorching in dry Indian region
items.description: Rising heat and water scarcity are deepening old caste inequalities in Bundelkhand region, activists say.
